page.overview:
What is Aquaraiders?

The Aquaraiders are a faction of Aquazone introduced in 1997.

The Aquaraiders fleet consists of three vessels in black with dark green accents and transparent fluorescent green window pieces. The front windows sport stickers with angry eyes on them. The focus changes from simply collecting crystals to underwater mining. The ships have accessories that resemble drills (note that actual drills were not introduced until the release of Rock Raiders in 1999) and grinders and have quite an exotic look for submarines, with 2161 Aqua Dozer even featuring an excavator bucket and 2162 Hydro Reef Wrecker having wheels.

The sly and sneaky Aquaraiders are a third faction that antagonizes both the Aquanauts and the Aquasharks, with both opposing factions regarding the Aquaraiders as villains. They are known to scavenge mine the seabed for Hydrolator Crystals, while also tricking the Aquanauts and Aquasharks in order to steal crystals and equipment from both of them. In The Adventures of the LEGO Maniac, the Crystal Scavenger steals a crystal that the Aquanauts and Aquasharks are fighting over, leading to Jock Clouseau and Thresher forming an alliance with the LEGO Maniac to trap the Crystal Scavenger and retrieve the crystal.

They're mean, they're green, they're drilling machines! These devious dwellers of the deep use their drills to discover new stashes of crystals hidden in solid rock. The raiders spend their days devising plans to trick the Aquanauts and Aquasharks out of their hydrolator crystals.
